name: 19 sentjabrja
source:
The main plot revolves around a nineteen-year-old heroine whose life is far from the ideal she strives to achieve. She faces her father's debts, conflicts with her boyfriend, financial difficulties, unrealized dreams, and constant attempts to please everyone. Could the situation get any worse?
"September 19" will find the answer to that question. However, now another question arises - can you change everything when the chance is given?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/mydots/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
主要情节围绕一位十九岁的女主角展开，她的生活与她努力实现的理想相去甚远。她面临着父亲的债务、与男友的矛盾、经济困难、未实现的梦想，以及不断试图取悦所有人。情况还会变得更糟吗？
《9月19日》将会找到这个问题的答案。然而，现在另一个问题出现了——当有机会的时候你能改变一切吗？

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/mydots/about]Patreon[/url]]
